data.model_answer_en:
Unity is Strength

Once there lived an old farmer. He had four sons. But the sons always quarrelled with one another. The old man was very worried about them. He wanted to teach them a lesson.

One day he called his sons and gave them a bundle of sticks. He asked each of them to break the bundle. One by one they tried with all their strength, but none could break it. Then the old man untied the bundle and gave each son a single stick. This time they broke the sticks very easily.

On the other hand, the cost of living is low in a village but very high in a town. People in villages are simple and friendly and help one another, whereas town people are busy and have little time for their neighbours. However, both have their own charms. A village gives peace and a healthy life, while a town gives comfort and opportunities. To sum up, though town life is more comfortable, village life is more peaceful and healthy. A wise person enjoys the good sides of both.

As a result of load-shedding, our daily life is greatly hampered. Students cannot study properly at night. Mills and factories cannot run smoothly, so the production falls.
